title: Stalthos terrain definition
description: Authoring input for the environment stage (terrain generation, hydrology, biome classification). One file per island or tile cluster. Every parameter here is an approximation chosen for display plausibility, not a measured geophysical quantity; the command emits Metric.measured=false for anything it cannot actually measure.

schema.description: Which contract this document claims to satisfy.

kind.description: Geographic scope. 'archipelago' seeds one run of the heightfield over the whole extent; 'island' is the common case.

id.description: Stable logical id, e.g. 'terrain.serrawhal.island'. Used for artifact ids and report filenames.

uncertainty.description: Highest tier of speculation in this file. Terrain shapes here are invented landforms, not reconstructions of any real place.

extent.description: Horizontal extent of the heightfield, in metres. Square, axis-aligned.

seed_point.description: Optional provenance note only; the pipeline is seed-driven, not coordinate-driven.

resolution.description: Heightfield sampling. cells is the grid edge count; cell_size_m is derived as size_m / cells and reported, not authored.

cells.description: Grid edge count (cells x cells samples).

cell_size_m.description: Optional authored cell size; conflicts with size_m/cells are reported as a warning.

sea_level.description: Mean sea level in metres. Cells at or below this are submerged.

elevation_range_m.description: Authored relief hint, [low, high] in metres. The generator produces something in this band; it is not a measurement.

generator.description: Heightfield shaping parameters. All fields optional; defaults give a plausible volcanic island with a central ridge.

shelf_width_cells.description: Width of the shallow shelf ring around the island.

hydrology.description: Flow routing and water-table parameters. Everything here is a display approximation: no solver, no mass balance.

sea_level_m.description: Drainage sink elevation. Defaults to the document's sea_level.

sea_level_tolerance_m.description: Flat cells within this height of sea level are treated as water.

depression_filling.description: How sink holes are handled before routing. 'breached' is deterministic and cheap; 'priority_flood' is the plainer approximation; 'none' leaves pits unrouted.

water_table_base_m.description: Percolation floor above sea level, in metres.

water_table_gain.description: How much elevation raises the perched water table.

cumulative_infiltration_mm.description: Capacity above which runoff is allowed to form.

biomes.description: Biome classification overrides and thresholds. Codes and briefs are fixed by the implementation; this block only supplies thresholds, dominant-biome forcing and tags.

dominant_biome.description: 'auto' keeps the largest emergent biome; any other value forces it and reports the share it holds.

force_biomes.description: Biome names that may be emitted. Restricting the palette is useful for tiles meant to sit inside one flora brief.

wetland_water_table_m.description: Water-table depth below which wetland is possible.

scrub_slope.description: Slope (rise/run) at or above which scrub replaces grassland.

alpine_heat_deficit.description: Elevation above which the profile is alpine regardless of wetness.

montane_heat_deficit.description: Elevation above which the profile is montane rather than warm.

grassland_wetness.description: At or below this wetness, grassland becomes scrub.

depth_steps_m.description: Extra submerged depth bands, ascending, for bespoke depth palettes.

tags.description: Free-form habitat tags carried into the biome report; they must already appear in the Rauken flora/ecology briefs.

provenance.description: Where this landform came from. Planning documents are legitimate sources; invented coordinates are not.

uncertainty.description: Highest tier of speculation anywhere in the document.

biome.description: Biome name from the fixed implementation palette (alpine, montane, drainage, mangrove, wetland, riparian, tidal, shoreline, coastal, grassland, scrub, subtidal, deepsea).

reference.description: A source consulted for this definition. usage_rights absent => uncertainty tier 'unverified' + warning.

locator.description: Relative path, URL or DOI. Never invented.
